entries: I have zero self-control around anyone who's bad for me.
I don't kiss and tell, but this group has earned one story.
My ex still texts me late at night, and I still answer.
Two of my exes have hooked up with each other.
I know exactly which text to send to get invited over.
My just-friends voice gets a lot more convincing after midnight.
I flirt first, ask permission later, and it's worked every time.
I've slept with someone the week after meeting them, more than once.
Ask me about my situationship. It's a whole story.
I've never regretted anyone I went home with.
I hooked up with a roommate once and we still live together.
Someone in this room already has my number, and knows it.
I slept with someone on a setup date and never called back.
One good line is usually all it takes to close me.
I don't chase. I just make it impossible to forget me.
We agreed never to talk about the hot tub again.
I've got a number I'm not proud of, and it's rising.
Somebody who isn't my partner still calls me baby.
I don't do exes as friends. I do them as warnings.
I've never made long distance work. Temptation's the reason.
I've thrown up in a cab and still made it to brunch.
I blacked out and bought a round for the whole bar.
I have a guy who gets us into places that are closed.
That bouncer has physically carried me out twice, and we're friendly now.
I got banned from a bar for climbing on the actual bar.
I skipped a bar tab once and changed bars for a year.
I got cut off once and argued my way to one more.
My last round of shots ended with me in a stranger's car.
There's a photo of me asleep in a stranger's front yard.
I've woken up wearing an outfit that wasn't mine.
I know my limit and I've never once respected it.
That's not the first bar I've been asked to leave.
I got escorted out of a bar and came right back.
I bailed someone out of jail last weekend. They still owe me.
My phone ended up in the freezer once. No memory of why.
Something got broken at the after-party and everyone blamed me.
I ate an edible before a flight and don't remember landing.
I got kicked out of an Uber for being sick in it.
I shoplifted a candy bar once just to see if I could.
Somebody still has my jacket from a night I don't remember.
